title: Shinonome Akito — Huddle Of Resolve〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Let's hurry, Akito.
We have to be there to meet the others in five minutes.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I definitely miscalculated...
That place isn't always so busy.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It was still very good.
Thank you for introducing it to me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure thing. On top of all their different pancakes, their menu's got a big selection of other food you can get.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The rice omelet you got looked pretty good, so I might have to order one next time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It was.
And I'm sure you'll also enjoy it.

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: Hey, look...!

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: Yeah, wait...! Aren't they...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Again...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
This has been happening a lot lately.
Everyone keeps staring at us.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I've been getting that feeling as well.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But there's nothing we can do.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Your performance and Shiraishi's battle against Azusawa have made us the center of attention.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Right...
But I still don't feel all that comfortable...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Still, I like the tension I'm feeling in the air.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Me too. I feel even more motivated to exceed their expectations.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Also, this feeling...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's similar to back when...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (This place...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
(It's wall-to-wall with locals and regulars.
She doesn't have home-field advantage here...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Akito?
You went quiet all of a sudden. Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No... Nothing's wrong.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I was just thinking that this is how things felt when I saw RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
This buzz I'm sensing now...
It's sort of warping the air, you know?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I've also felt this before.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Though not at RAD WEEKEND, of course.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, where'd you feel it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: When I went to see a concert by this one world-class orchestra. The hall buzzed with a similar sort of excitement.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: As the starting time slowly approached, everything became quieter and quieter. I could almost hear the breathing of each musician change as the anticipation grew.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What we're feeling in the air right now may be because of that kind of anticipation. Everyone around here is looking forward to what's coming.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Then...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (That means we gotta give them what they want.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (The fire I ignited in everyone is still burning strong.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And now, we need to fan those flames into an inferno.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Toya.
Let's hurry back over to Ken's place.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I feel like it doesn't matter who we're battling against today. I think we can beat anyone right now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're gonna win no matter what!
